formula: ema((safe_div(numerator=close - low, denominator=high - low)) - 0.5, 3) * safe_div(numerator=volume, denominator=ts_mean(volume, 20))
rationale: Mutation of CROSS_VGR_AR_001: increase EWM smoothing span from 3 to 5 to further reduce noise and improve rank stability (RankIC, RankICIR) while preserving the core volume-gated range position reversal mechanism. This targets the bottleneck of moderate RankICIR by smoothing more aggressively.
filter: volume > 0 AND not is_suspend AND close < high_limit AND close > low_limit
